senses.definition: n.pr.m. (cf. Palm. n.pr.m. גריבא Vog 141) one of David’s heroes 2 S 23:38 = 1 Ch 11:40.
n.pr.loc. (cf. Sab. n.pr.loc. גרבם HalNo. 379, 382) only in גִּבְעַת גָּרֵב Je 31:39 hill of Gareb, appar. close to Jerusalem on the SW. cf. Gf; v. also Hi Che.
